      Guided path, 8 steps

        04 Final productThe finished Argus, as a clickable prototype

        Five screens in one flow: type an issue, watch the run, review the verdict and the before/after, see the PR the agent raises, then check history. Everything inside the frame is a prototype: nothing is uploaded, no model is called, and no pull request is ever created. Use the switcher to see the quota, stuck, verifier-failed and judge-disagrees cases.

          05

          Fix report: before and after on the production UI

          This is the file the agent hands the owner. It opens on its own, shows the ticket, the proof, the diff and the screen before and after, then ends in one decision: Approve and raise the PR, Request changes or Reject. Below it is a sample for seeded bug-17, then what has to be built to generate it for real.

          REAL: a file in the repo backs it FIXTURE: a file exists, a canned replay made it ILLUSTRATIVE: no artifact behind it PLANNED: nothing built yet

          The report data (window.ARGUS.report) is not loaded. Run node analysis/explainer-src/build.mjs with analysis/swarm/report.json present.
